run_download_and_tokenize_snli: run the script to download the SNLI dataset and tokenize all sentences using spaCy
run_main_snli_tokenization: run main to tokenize SNLI train dev and test splits into JSONL format with spaCy
create_tokenized_snli_jsonl: create tokenized JSONL files from the SNLI dataset by processing sentence pairs with spaCy
refactor_main_custom_tokenizer: refactor main to accept a custom tokenizer instead of hardcoding spaCy for sentence tokenization
review_main_snli_pipeline: review the main function that downloads SNLI and tokenizes sentence pairs using spaCy and jsonlines
